content:
I've formalized key results from a proof of the Erdős prime divisibility conjecture for binomial coefficients (for all 1 ≤ i < j ≤ n/2, there exists a prime p ≥ i dividing gcd(C(n,i), C(n,j))).

The Lean 4 file verifies 27 results with zero sorry and zero custom axioms. Every #print axioms call returns only [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Verified results include:

  • Master Identity: C(n,j)·C(j,i) = C(n,i)·C(n-i,j-i)
  • Carry Lemma: p | C(r + p^V, j) for p ≤ j < p^V (new result, from Vandermonde + Kummer)
  • Tame Prime Lemma: q ∈ (j-i, j], q > i implies q | C(j,i)
  • Case B-α (Untame Escape): q | C(n,i) and q ∤ C(j,i) implies q | C(n,j)
  • FO Characterisation: in a fully obstructed triple, every prime r > i in C(n,i) divides C(j,i)
  • Absorption identity and partial i=1 case
  • All 8 known fully obstructed triples verified by native_decide
  • All M=1 structures verified by omega

Repository: https://github.com/srinikethpsarathy-oss/Erdos-verification-suite

The paper is submitted to JXM. I am also looking for an arXiv endorser for math.CO or math.NT if anyone is able to help.
